description: This Java source file defines an abstract class for command strategies that check HTTP conditional headers based on entity tags (ETags). It includes methods for applying header validation and determining if the strategy is applicable to a given command and entity.

classes.name: AbstractConditionHeaderCheckingCommandStrategy
classes.description: An abstract class for command strategies that validate HTTP conditional headers based on entity tags, supporting command handling with entity and event types.

methods.name: AbstractConditionHeaderCheckingCommandStrategy
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the strategy with the specific command class it handles.

methods.name: getValidator
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the conditional headers validator used for header validation.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Validates conditional headers for a command and entity, returning an error result if validation fails, or proceeding with the command processing.

methods.name: isDefined
methods.description: Checks if the command is applicable to the given entity based on entity ID matching.
